card.name: Linking words in instructions to a child or patient
card.fires_on: Small connecting words (tell, for, to, then, in, with) inside step-by-step instructions, such as safety rules for children or directions for mixing a dose in food or water.

modes.label: Child safety advice
modes.description: Verbs and linking words in rules telling a child what to do and whom to tell.
modes.example: Use the “Power NO,” get away from the situation and<< tell>> a trusted adult.

modes.label: Mixing doses into food or drink
modes.description: Linking words just before the food or liquid a dose is added to.
modes.example: Sprinkle and mix the granules<< in>> applesauce, berry jelly or fruit juice
